findings.description: The client parameter was renamed from `attempts` to `max_attempts`, but create_ticket still passes `attempts=1`. It is no longer recognised, so it falls into `**fields` and is sent as a JSON body field `attempts`. `max_attempts` stays at the default of 3. A transport timeout or 5xx on this non-idempotent POST is now retried up to 3 times with backoff, which can create duplicate tickets. The vendor API may also reject the unknown `attempts` field.
findings.suggestion: Change `attempts=1` to `max_attempts=1` in the create_ticket call.
